description: Source-owned, fail-closed evidence lifecycle metadata. Review routing classifies obligations; this registry records whether a public record is evidence-bound, explicitly held, or still unbound. Presence of a review document never upgrades currentness by itself.

analiz-fidov-likvidatsiy-kriptovalyut.note: Disputed liquidation-feed claims remain source-unbound; the adjudication receipt records the HOLD only and does not satisfy the missing primary-source requirement.

rynochno-neytralnye-kriptostrategii-2026.note: Later rejection/non-promotion evidence conflicts with current-looking guidance. The adjudication receipt preserves a fail-closed HOLD pending source reconciliation.

simulyatsiya-ispolneniya-kripto-strategi.note: Research/simulation material must not be treated as implementation guidance until claim-level source evidence and execution assumptions are rebound.

kriptotreyding-i-quant-issledovaniya.note: Unsupported quant/execution claims remain source cleanup work; the adjudication receipt must not be read as proof that those claims were removed or verified.

obzor-vsekh-torgovykh-strategiy.note: Unsupported strategy claims remain source-level cleanup work. The adjudication receipt records the unresolved state without deleting or silently upgrading historical material.
